svg.title: 19. Floodplain city — experimental Bellweather map
svg.desc: Raised settlements connect through an embankment network above wet lowlands. The geography emphasizes which raised roads offer alternate approaches. Only printed routes define adjacency for every effect. District footprints and route intersections create no additional links. Three regions hold eighteen Support each; Bellweather holds three separately.
svg.text: Urban 18 Support / 9 votes Mixed 18 / 9 Outlying 18 / 9 Bellweather 3 separate
Only printed routes create adjacency. Every route joins its two endpoint districts for all effects.
Nearby footprints are not adjacent. Double-railed spans mark the special crossings and corridors listed in the companion notes.
Experimental concept · 26 connections · 1 dead-end districts: see study notes · District elections remain local
